title: Isolation of Artemia nauplii for DNA extraction
author: Dave Lunt

steps_raw.title: Prepare conical filter from Whatman #1
steps_raw.instruction: 150mm circle paper folded into cone and stapled Whatman #1 paper Contributed by users Catalog #1001150
Place in glass funnel over beaker
Pour in Artemia culture and let drain through

steps_raw.title: Remove Artemia from centre of paper to 1.5ml tube
steps_raw.instruction: leave eggs behind as much as possible

steps_raw.title: Spin for 30 seconds in microfuge to pellet Artemia
Discard supernatant
steps_raw.instruction: ie remove fluid with pipette to concentrate the Artemia

steps_raw.title: Spin for 30 seconds in microfuge to pellet Artemia
